title: Macroplan
description: A week-by-week delivery plan. Portable TOML format v2 — see docs/format.md. Validates the TOML-decoded structure; dates are TOML date literals, surfaced to JSON Schema as date-formatted strings.

macroplan_version.description: Format version. Omit for the current version (2). Version 2 adds nested Features (`parent`, `weeks`, `reestimate_weeks`); a plan without them is also a valid version 1 file. A consumer must reject a version newer than it understands.

title.description: Display name of the plan. Defaults to "Untitled Macroplan" when absent.

start.description: Optional left edge of the plan's week span. Only extends the span; never clips a feature. Snapped to its ISO-week Monday.

end.description: Optional right edge of the plan's week span. Only extends the span; never clips a feature. Snapped to its ISO-week Monday.

feature.description: The features of the plan. Written as [[feature]] blocks. Names must be unique.

unavailable.description: Weeks the whole team is off (holidays, shutdown, offsite). Written as [[unavailable]] blocks. Drawn only: moves no date, Duration or Forecast, and never widens the plan's span.

date.description: A calendar date (TOML date literal, e.g. 2026-06-15). Snapped to its ISO-week Monday.

name.description: Identifies the feature; the join key for a milestone's `requires`. Must be unique within the plan.

start.description: The week work began. On a top-level Feature without children: required. In a chain: only on its first leaf, where it anchors the whole chain.

original.description: The Original Estimate — the immovable baseline all lateness is judged against (ADR-0001). Top-level Features without children only; a child's is derived from its `weeks`.

reestimates.description: Each later week the estimate slipped to. Order-independent. Top-level Features without children only; a child uses `reestimate_weeks`.

delivered.description: The week the feature actually shipped. Absent means still in flight.

status.description: In-flight confidence. Meaningful only while undelivered. Lateness is derived, never authored.

area.description: The Area this feature belongs to — a named group sharing a discipline or owner. Omit for ungrouped. Matched case-insensitively after trimming; a feature belongs to at most one Area (ADR-0003). Top-level Features only — children sit in their parent's Area.

parent.description: Name of the parent Feature, making this one a child (ADR-0004). Siblings chain in file order: each starts the week after the one before ends. Requires format version 2.

weeks.description: A child's planned Duration in whole weeks. Its Original Estimate is the last week of this Duration, counted from the end of the previous sibling.

reestimate_weeks.description: A child's re-estimated Durations, each longer than the one before (a Re-estimate is always a slip). Each `△` lands at the child's real start plus that Duration.

feature.description: A Feature. Which date/Duration keys it may carry depends on its place in the tree (see docs/format.md): a top-level Feature without children needs `start` and `original`; a child needs `weeks` (and the first leaf of a chain also `start`); a parent carries no dates — they are derived from its children. The schema checks shape only; consumers enforce these positional rules.

requires.description: Feature names that must be delivered on/before `week` to meet the milestone.

name.description: Label of the period, e.g. "Christmas break".

to.description: The last week off, inclusive. Absent means the single week of `from`. Must not be before `from`.
